description: Louisiana motorcycle delta: helmet law and lane rules. National riding skills stay in core_motorcycle.json.

questions.q: Who must wear a helmet on a motorcycle in Louisiana?
questions.explanation: Louisiana has a universal helmet law. Every rider and passenger must wear a helmet.

questions.q: An adult passenger on a motorcycle in Louisiana
questions.explanation: The Louisiana helmet law covers passengers as well as the operator.

questions.q: What does Louisiana law say about riding a motorcycle between lanes of traffic?
options: Only lane filtering is allowed, when traffic is stopped or slow
Riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed
questions.explanation: Louisiana: riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed.

questions.q: In Louisiana, what is the youngest age for a motorcycle learner's permit?
questions.explanation: Louisiana issues a motorcycle permit at 15 years at the earliest.
